verdict.rationale: A dedicated first-party MCP doc page says MCP gives 'ChatGPT or Codex' access to third-party tools such as the browser or Figma. It also shows how to add an MCP server (the Context7 example) and documents configuration in config.toml, with project-scoped servers via .codex/config.toml. Configured servers carry across clients without redoing setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use, and clear setup details for ChatGPT itself (Chat/Work) as opposed to Codex, whose config.toml dominates the docs.
